name: adelin-b
description: Skills that stay current with their upstream sources, compose with each other under cross-cutting rules, and detect drift across schemas and code.

plugins.name: skill-sync
plugins.description: Detect drift between a skill and its upstream sources (npm version, changelog hash, docs hash, GitHub release hash). Regenerate body, stamp upstream_hash + last_synced.
plugins.author: adelin-b

plugins.name: skill-compose
plugins.description: Combine N source skills into a derived skill under a compose rule. Walks frame → axes → ≥3 variants → weakest links → Pareto → pick + justify; persists alternatives in frontmatter.
plugins.author: adelin-b

plugins.name: skill-audit
plugins.description: Scan every SKILL.md plus project's package.json. Surface integration opportunities, trigger contradictions, weak composes, stale primaries, expired validity. Propose the highest-leverage next move.
plugins.author: adelin-b

plugins.name: schema-drift
plugins.description: Detect schemas drifted across layers (forms, API contracts, DB models, GraphQL/tRPC/Convex). Inventory the stack, recommend the single source-of-truth pattern, propose one concrete refactor with the right tool to enforce it.
plugins.author: adelin-b

plugins.name: code-drift
plugins.description: Detect code drifted from upstream truth — shims for closed issues, deprecated APIs, broken doc links, version-stale workarounds, intra-repo pattern divergence. Zero-LLM detection via off-the-shelf tools, AI invoked only for focused fixes. Inspired by mex-agent.
plugins.author: adelin-b
